title: Network pharmacology and experimental verification of the potential mechanism of Er-Xian decoction in aplastic anemia.
authors: Ye, Mei; Liu, Guangxian; Yang, Yujun; Yang, Hongyu; Ren, Juan; Chen, Wenfei; Gao, Zeli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究二仙汤治疗再生障碍性贫血的网络药理学与实验验证，核心为药物-靶点-通路分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: To investigate the potential mechanism of Er-Xian decoction (EXD) in treating aplastic anemia (AA), the active components of EXD were screened by the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP), and the targets of the components were predicted by the Swiss Target Prediction database. AA targets were collected from the GeneCards, OMIM, DisGeNET, PharmGKB, DrugBank, and TTD databases, the intersection of AA targets and EXD targets was calculated, and an herb-component-target network was constructed by Cytoscape 3.7.2 software. The STRING database was used for protein‒protein interaction (PPI) analysis, and Cytoscape 3.7.2 software was used to construct a PPI network and perform topology analysis. The core targets were imported into the DAVID database for gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses. The molecular docking software AutoDock was used to measure the affinity between active components and key targets. Finally, we established a mouse model of AA and verified the key targets and signaling pathways of EXD by RT‒PCR, ELISA and Western blot analysis. A total of 53 active components were screened from EXD, 2516 AA-related targets were collected, and 195 common targets were obtained. An herb-component-target network and a PPI network were successfully constructed, and 36 core targets were selected from the PPI network. The main active components of EXD include luteolin, kaempferol, berberine, etc., and key targets include PIK3CA, AKT1, STAT3, etc. GO functional enrichment analysis showed that cell components, molecular functions and biological processes with significant correlations were macromolecular complexes, protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity and protein phosphorylation, respectively. KEGG pathway analysis showed that the pathways with significant correlations included the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway and JAK-STAT signaling pathway. Molecular docking results showed that the tested key targets had good affinity for the corresponding active components. In AA mice, we found that EXD significantly increased white blood cell count, red blood cell count, platelet count and hemoglobin levels, increased mRNA levels of PIK3CA, PIK3CD, AKT1, JAK2, STAT3 and MAPK1, and promoted phosphorylation of PI3K, AKT, ERK1/2 and STAT3. In summary, EXD acts on PI3K, AKT, STAT3 and other targets through berberine, luteolin, quercetin and other components to regulate the PI3K-Akt pathway, JAK-STAT pathway and other pathways, thus exerting its therapeutic effect on AA. This study explained the Chinese medicine theory of treating AA with EXD by tonifying kidney-yang and provides a scientific basis for the use of EXD in treating AA.
abstract_zh: 为探讨二仙汤（EXD）治疗再生障碍性贫血（AA）的潜在机制，通过中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）筛选EXD的活性成分，并利用Swiss Target Prediction数据库预测成分靶点。从GeneCards、OMIM、DisGeNET、PharmGKB、DrugBank和TTD数据库收集AA靶点，计算AA靶点与EXD靶点的交集，并通过Cytoscape 3.7.2软件构建药物-成分-靶点网络。使用STRING数据库进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析，并利用Cytoscape 3.7.2软件构建PPI网络并进行拓扑分析。将核心靶点导入DAVID数据库进行基因本体（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路分析。使用分子对接软件AutoDock测量活性成分与关键靶点之间的亲和力。最后，我们建立AA小鼠模型，并通过RT-PCR、ELISA和Western blot分析验证EXD的关键靶点和信号通路。从EXD中筛选出共53个活性成分，收集到2516个AA相关靶点，并获得195个共同靶点。成功构建药物-成分-靶点网络和PPI网络，并从PPI网络中选出36个核心靶点。EXD的主要活性成分包括木犀草素、山柰酚、小檗碱等，关键靶点包括PIK3CA、AKT1、STAT3等。GO功能富集分析显示，显著相关的细胞组分、分子功能和生物过程分别为大分子复合物、蛋白丝氨酸/苏氨酸/酪氨酸激酶活性和蛋白质磷酸化。KEGG通路分析显示，显著相关的通路包括PI3K-Akt信号通路和JAK-STAT信号通路。分子对接结果显示，测试的关键靶点与相应活性成分具有良好的亲和力。在AA小鼠中，我们发现EXD显著增加白细胞计数、红细胞计数、血小板计数和血红蛋白水平，提高PIK3CA、PIK3CD、AKT1、JAK2、STAT3和MAPK1的mRNA水平，并促进PI3K、AKT、ERK1/2和STAT3的磷酸化。总之，EXD通过小檗碱、木犀草素、槲皮素等成分作用于PI3K、AKT、STAT3等靶点，调节PI3K-Akt通路、JAK-STAT通路等，从而发挥其对AA的治疗作用。本研究阐释了EXD通过温补肾阳治疗AA的中医理论，并为EXD治疗AA提供了科学依据。
